title: 介绍朋友，也让别人认识你
subtitle: Talking about friends and finding things in common

audio.title: Who are your friends?
audio.note: 使用完整音频 1分05.53秒。已实际打开来源页，验证页面原音可播放、时长为 65.53 秒，并核对同页完整 Script 与音频匹配。第一遍先不要看 Script；完整原文在来源页的 Script 区域。

sections.title: 1. 无字幕先听｜她怎样介绍三位朋友（4分钟）
sections.body:
打开来源页，播放完整 1分05秒。第一遍不要往下看 Script，也不要暂停或逐词翻译，只判断说话者在介绍自己、朋友，还是一次旅行。

第二遍只抓人名、地点和描述词：Desiree、South Africa、Candace、Lisa、Mandy、Wales、hair、funny、miss。没听出的地方先放过。

第三遍完成两道主旨题，并估计第一次无字幕听懂比例。答完后才能进入精听。第三方原文仅短提示一句：“Who are your friends?”
questions: Desiree 来自哪里？她主要谈论谁？
她怎样描述 Mandy？她为什么想念 Lisa？
sections.answers:
1. She is from South Africa, and she mainly talks about her friends Candace, Lisa and Mandy.
2. Mandy has blonde hair, is very funny and makes Desiree laugh. Lisa lives in Wales, so Desiree only speaks to her through messages and misses her.

sections.title: 2. 精听辨音＋连读弱读（5分钟）
sections.body:
每处按“只听两遍 → 看提示 → 模仿两遍 → 关文字重听”练习。

① Who are your friends?｜Who_are 自然连接；are 常弱读 /ə/，重音落在 friends。
② She makes me laugh a lot.｜makes_me 会连起来；a 很轻，laugh 和 lot 更清楚。
③ I only speak to her on messages.｜to 常弱读 /tə/；speak_to 连读，her 也可能很轻。

最后先听一个意群，暂停后模仿节奏，再关掉文字重听完整 1分05秒。目标是听出词块，不是在脑中把每个词翻译成中文。
questions: Who are your friends? 中哪个词通常最重？
speak to her 中 to 常弱读成什么？

sections.title: 3. 原创阅读｜在语言交换活动介绍朋友（4分钟）
sections.body: At a language exchange, Nina met Leo for the first time. She introduced herself and then pointed to her friend Mei across the room. Nina and Mei met at university four years ago. Mei is quiet at first, but she is warm, reliable and very funny once she feels comfortable. She often makes Nina laugh when work becomes stressful. They both enjoy trying small cafés and taking photos, so they usually spend Saturday afternoons together. Leo asked what Mei looked like because several people were standing near the window. Nina explained that Mei had short black hair and wore round glasses. When Mei joined them, Nina introduced Leo and mentioned that he also loved photography. The three soon found a lot in common. Nina did not translate every sentence in her head; she listened for key words, used short answers and asked simple follow-up questions.
questions: What is Mei like, and what do she and Nina enjoy doing together?
How did Nina help Mei and Leo start talking?
sections.translation: 在一次语言交换活动中，妮娜第一次遇见利奥。她先介绍自己，然后指向房间另一边的朋友梅。妮娜和梅四年前在大学相识。梅刚开始比较安静，但熟悉之后，她温暖、可靠而且非常幽默。工作压力大时，她常把妮娜逗笑。两人都喜欢尝试小咖啡馆和拍照，所以通常一起度过周六下午。利奥问梅长什么样，因为窗边站着好几个人。妮娜解释说，梅留着黑色短发，戴圆框眼镜。梅过来后，妮娜介绍了利奥，并提到他也喜欢摄影。三人很快发现彼此有许多共同点。妮娜没有在脑中翻译每句话；她听关键词、用简短回答，并问简单的追问。
sections.answers:
1. Mei is quiet at first, then warm, reliable and funny. She and Nina enjoy visiting small cafés and taking photos.
2. Nina introduced them and mentioned that Leo also loved photography.

sections.title: 4. 词汇与高频词块｜介绍自己和朋友（4分钟）
sections.body:
1. Let me introduce myself.｜让我自我介绍一下。｜Let me introduce myself—I'm Nina. 让我自我介绍一下，我叫妮娜。
2. This is my friend ...｜这是我的朋友……｜This is my friend Mei. 这是我的朋友梅。
3. We met at ...｜我们在……认识。｜We met at university. 我们在大学认识。
4. We've been friends for ...｜我们做朋友已经……｜We've been friends for four years. 我们做朋友已经四年了。
5. What is she like?｜她是怎样的人？｜What is Mei like? 梅性格怎么样？
6. We have a lot in common.｜我们有许多共同点。｜We both love photos, so we have a lot in common. 我们都爱摄影，所以有许多共同点。
7. She makes me laugh.｜她把我逗笑。｜She makes me laugh after a hard day. 辛苦一天后，她会把我逗笑。
8. keep in touch｜保持联系｜Lisa and I keep in touch by message. 我和莉萨通过消息保持联系。
9. reliable｜可靠的｜Mei is reliable when I need help. 我需要帮助时，梅很可靠。
sections.answers: 优先记住 8 个词块：Let me introduce myself. / This is my friend ... / We met at ... / We've been friends for ... / What is she like? / We have a lot in common. / She makes me laugh. / keep in touch。

sections.title: 5. 语法｜What is she like? 与 What does she look like?（3分钟）
sections.body:
What is someone like? 询问性格或为人；What does someone look like? 询问外貌。不要把 like 单独翻成“喜欢”。

例句 1：What is Mandy like? — She's funny and friendly. 曼迪性格怎么样？——她幽默又友好。
例句 2：What does Candace look like? — She has long brown hair. 坎迪斯长什么样？——她留着棕色长发。
questions: 选择：想问梅的性格，应说 What is Mei like? / What does Mei look like?
完成对话：What does Leo look like? — He ___ short black hair.

sections.title: 6. 原创对话＋替换＋快速回应（3分钟）
sections.body:
原创双人对话
A: Hi, let me introduce myself. I'm Nina.
B: Nice to meet you. I'm Leo. Who's your friend by the window?
A: That's Mei. We met at university four years ago.
B: What is she like?
A: She's quiet at first, but she's warm and funny. We both love photography.
B: Me too! It sounds like we have a lot in common.

替换练习
① met at university → met at work / met in a badminton club。
② warm and funny → outgoing and helpful；photography → cooking / hiking。

快速回应：3 秒内开口。
1) 新朋友问你叫什么名字。→ Let me introduce myself. I'm ...
2) 对方问你和朋友怎样认识。→ We met at ...
3) 对方问朋友性格。→ She's/He's ...

30–60 秒口头任务：介绍自己和一位朋友，说你们在哪里认识、认识多久、朋友的性格、一个共同爱好，最后问听者 Who are your friends? 不要先写中文再逐句翻译。
sections.answers: 示例：Hi, let me introduce myself. I'm Nina. My close friend is Mei. We met at university, and we've been friends for four years. She's quiet at first, but she's warm, reliable and funny. She makes me laugh. We both enjoy photography, so we have a lot in common. Who are your friends?

sections.title: 7. 前课复习＋反馈（1分钟）
sections.body:
复习昨天 3 个词块，并换成今天的朋友场景：
1. Nice to meet you.｜很高兴认识你。
2. How do you know ...?｜你怎么认识……？
3. What are you doing this weekend?｜你这周末做什么？

快速串联：Nice to meet you. How do you know Mei? What are you doing this weekend?

请回原聊天告诉我：① 第一次无字幕听懂了约百分之多少；② 最卡的是哪一句；③ 用英文文字或语音完成 30–60 秒口头任务。只有实际收到并分析你的语音后，我才会评价发音。
sections.answers: 完成标准：能不看文字说出 3 个复习词块，并用 30–60 秒完成“自我介绍＋朋友关系＋性格＋共同爱好”。
